evals.prompt: We're moving our k8s cluster (RKE2, 5 nodes) off fluent-bit to the OpenTelemetry Collector. Plan is the official opentelemetry-collector helm chart, collector 0.162, running as a DaemonSet. It needs to ship all pod logs AND kubernetes events to Loki, and it must not lose logs if Loki is down for a couple of hours. Write the values.yaml.
evals.expected_output: A values.yaml for the opentelemetry-collector chart in daemonset mode with current component names, events collected without duplication (not the kubernetesEvents preset in daemonset mode), a persistent byte-sized exporter queue that blocks instead of dropping, file_log checkpoints, otlp_http to Loki's OTLP endpoint (no loki exporter), image.repository set.
assertions: Runs the chart in daemonset mode (mode: daemonset)

Collects Kubernetes events WITHOUT relying on the kubernetesEvents preset inside the DaemonSet (uses kubernetesObjects with leader election in daemonset mode, or a separate single-replica Deployment/receiver with leader election), and explains why
Sends to Loki via the otlp_http/otlphttp exporter to Loki's native OTLP endpoint, not the removed `loki` exporter
Configures a persistent exporter queue (sending_queue.storage pointing at a file_storage extension on a hostPath)
Sizes the queue for a multi-hour outage explicitly (sizer: bytes with a byte queue_size, or an explicit calculation), not the 1000-request default
Sets block_on_overflow: true (or otherwise explicitly prevents the queue from dropping when full)
Sets retry_on_failure.max_elapsed_time to 0 or at least the outage length (default 300s would give up)
Persists file_log/filelog read offsets (storeCheckpoints: true or storage on the receiver)
Sets image.repository explicitly (the chart has no default)
Uses component names valid and current for 0.162 (e.g. file_log/otlp_http) or notes that old names are deprecated aliases

evals.prompt:
can you review this collector config before I roll it out? it's for otelcol-contrib 0.161

```yaml
receivers:
  filelog:
    include: [/var/log/pods/*/*/*.log]
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
processors:
  batch:
  k8sattributes:
  memory_limiter:
    limit_mib: 400
  routing:
    default_exporters: [otlphttp]
exporters:
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: https://otel.example.internal:4318
  loki:
    endpoint: http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push
service:
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [filelog, otlp]
      processors: [batch, k8sattributes, memory_limiter]
      exporters: [otlphttp, loki]
```
evals.expected_output: A review that flags: loki exporter and routing processor no longer exist; processor order wrong (memory_limiter first, k8s_attributes before batch); old component names are deprecated aliases (file_log, otlp_http, k8s_attributes); otlp receiver binds to localhost by default so it is unreachable in a pod; filelog has no storage/start_at/container parsing; exporter queue defaults drop data; no self-monitoring.
assertions: Flags that the `loki` exporter no longer exists in contrib 0.161 (removed in v0.131)
Flags that the `routing` processor no longer exists (removed, replaced by the routing connector)
Flags processor order: memory_limiter must be first
Flags that k8sattributes must run before batch
Flags that the otlp receiver binds to localhost by default (since v0.110) so it is unreachable from other pods unless bound to the pod IP
Flags filelog gaps: no storage/checkpoints and/or no container (CRI) parsing / start_at
Mentions that filelog/otlphttp/k8sattributes are deprecated aliases of file_log/otlp_http/k8s_attributes
Flags exporter sending_queue/retry defaults as a data-loss risk (queue drops when full and/or retry gives up after 5 min)

evals.prompt: I added the journald receiver to our otel collector (contrib 0.162) and send it to VictoriaLogs over OTLP. In VictoriaLogs every journal row says 'missing _msg field', severity shows Unspecified, the number of streams is exploding, and some messages we see with journalctl on the host never show up. What's going on and how do I fix the config?
evals.expected_output: Explains: without convert_to_semantic_conventions the journal record is a body map (no message/severity mapping) — set convert_to_semantic_conventions: true; priority defaults to info so debug lines are dropped — set priority: debug; VictoriaLogs makes every resource attribute a stream field (process.pid after the conversion) — set VL-Stream-Fields header; uses otlp_http (protobuf).
assertions: Recommends convert_to_semantic_conventions: true so MESSAGE becomes the body and PRIORITY the severity
Explains the journald receiver's default priority is info, dropping debug entries, and sets priority: debug
Explains VictoriaLogs turns every OTLP resource attribute into a stream field and sets the VL-Stream-Fields header to limit them
Identifies a per-process/per-record resource attribute (e.g. process.pid) as the stream-explosion source
Uses the otlp_http exporter (OTLP/HTTP protobuf) to VictoriaLogs' /insert/opentelemetry/v1/logs endpoint

evals.prompt: We're on otelcol-contrib 0.140.0 in production (air-gapped site, configs use filelog, k8sattributes, transform, prometheusremotewrite, the prometheus exporter with add_metric_suffixes: false, and dashboards built on k8s.pod.labels.app). I want to jump to the latest release. What will break or change, and how should I run the upgrade?
evals.expected_output: Lists relevant breaking changes between 0.140 and 0.162: snake_case renames (aliases still work), transform/filter error_mode default now ignore, add_metric_suffixes deprecated → translation_strategy and ignored by the prometheus exporter since 0.154, k8s_attributes v1 conventions rename k8s.pod.labels.* → k8s.pod.label.*, resource_to_telemetry_conversion deprecated, security floors; procedure: read every release's notes, validate with the new binary, check dashboards, verify cosign signatures offline, pin and keep rollback.
assertions: Explains the snake_case component renames (e.g. filelog→file_log, k8sattributes→k8s_attributes, prometheusremotewrite→prometheus_remote_write) and that old names still work as deprecated aliases
Warns that transform/filter error_mode now defaults to ignore (errors skipped silently)
Explains add_metric_suffixes is deprecated in favour of translation_strategy and is ignored by the prometheus exporter (since ~v0.154), so metric names may change
Warns that k8s_attributes now emits k8s.pod.label.<k> instead of k8s.pod.labels.<k>, breaking dashboards on k8s.pod.labels.app, and offers the dual-emit feature gates
Mentions resource_to_telemetry_conversion deprecation or the k8s_attributes container.image.tag→tags rename or another concrete semconv/attribute rename beyond the label one
Gives a security floor or names advisories fixed in the window (e.g. contrib ≥ 0.154/0.155)
Recommends validating the config with the new binary (otelcol validate) before rollout
Recommends reading the release notes of every intermediate release (many hops, two-week cadence)
Covers air-gap specifics: verifying cosign/Sigstore signatures (offline) and/or mirroring images
